verdicts.title: Arakelov geometry, heights, equidistribution, and the Bogomolov conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is an introduction to the topics of the title, from the 2017 Grenoble Summer school on Arakelov geometry and arithmetic applications. We review Arithmetic intersection numbers, explain the definition of the height of a variety and its properties, both in the framework of classical Arakelov geometry and of Zhang's adelic formalism.
